scanNotes: 2026-10-31: Added the confirmed free Krampusshow at Alszeilenmarkt (28 November 15:00) and Böhmischer Prater Perchtenlauf (13 December 17:00–18:30); the latter’s free admission and voluntary donations were verified in the organiser page’s expanded description in the browser. Rechecked the existing Prater parade (29 November 17:00), preserving its stable ID and unpublished finishing time. Oberlaa (20 November 18:30) is not listed: the organiser confirms date/time, but the only free-entry notice found was for 2025. Omitted Christmas Day Jewish Museum occurrences pending explicit holiday confirmation, following the user’s request to ignore unconfirmed items.

2026-10-31: Added 24 sourced free museum listings, weekly/monthly admission dates through 30 December, and a free museum directory. Honoured current winter/renovation closures and the HGM closure on 1 November. Published recurring admission rules used only with opening-hour checks; holiday caveats are explicit. Existing entertainment records and their checkedOn values are unchanged.

2026-10-31: Searched upcoming entertainment through 30 December and Indian touring/cultural events through 28 February 2027. Coverage is partial. Added Silent Ecologies (29 November, 15:00–18:00) and Party Modern (29 November, 18:00–21:30) after reading MUK’s individual organiser pages; both confirm free admission and limited places.

Removed completed 30 October occurrences of Happy Friday and Prater Halloween. Preserved stable IDs and future dates. Rechecked seven Charlie P’s records, Prater Halloween and Karawoke against accessible venue/organiser pages; no additional dates inferred.

The Alma Rosé venue page was inaccessible, but its linked Eventjet organiser booking listing confirms 3 November, 19:00–21:00, Ehrbar Saal and EUR 0 tickets. Added the published finishing time. The seat-map page exposes no readable live availability, so the booking caveat and prior venue-page checked date are retained.

American Improv’s YesTicket page and Bhajan Clubbing Austria’s Eventbrite event page were inaccessible. Bhajan Clubbing remains an unlisted 1 November lead at NordbahnSaal: current live prices and mandatory fees could not be verified. Prior search excerpts disagreed on starting price. No paid listing was added from incomplete booking information.

Read 48er-Tandler’s 12 November Pandora’s Box screening announcement, which confirms free entry but does not specify English intertitles/subtitles. Not added. Wider cinema/theatre, Indian touring and nearby/fireworks searches yielded no other fully verified additions. No nearby travel was assumed.

All other future records retain their prior checked dates. MQ winter directory and press search results were reviewed but individual winter concert sources were not rechecked. Public JSON readback was unverified in the preceding run; this update will be checked again after the Pages build.

events.description: Uniforms, historic equipment and stories from more than three centuries of Vienna’s fire service.
events.details: Sundays and public holidays 09:00–12:00; Tuesdays 14:00–17:00. If Tuesday is a public holiday, morning holiday hours apply instead. The museum is step-free.
events.admission: Free museum admission.
events.language: Self-guided museum visit; check the original page for available text and audio languages.

events.title: Vienna Fire Brigade Museum — holiday opening
events.subtitle: Free holiday visit
events.description: Visit Vienna’s historic fire-service collection during its morning public-holiday opening.
events.details: On a Tuesday public holiday, the museum opens 09:00–12:00 instead of its usual Tuesday afternoon hours.
events.admission: Free museum admission.
events.language: Self-guided museum visit; check the original page for available text and audio languages.

events.title: Museum Simon Wiesenthal — free entry
events.subtitle: Free throughout the year
events.description: Discover Simon Wiesenthal’s work documenting Nazi crimes and pursuing accountability after the Holocaust.
events.details: September to June: Monday to Friday 10:00–18:00; closed public holidays. Bring photo ID. Groups should register in advance. Recheck arrangements during the Christmas holiday period.
events.admission: Museum entry free. Bring photo ID.
events.language: Self-guided museum visit; check the original page for available text and audio languages.
Spoken announcements are not specified; the focus is the visual parade and show.
events.title: Krampusshow at Alszeilenmarkt
events.subtitle: Masks, fire effects and folklore
events.description: Nigri Diaboli bring Krampus costumes, fire performers, witches and St Nicholas to the market.
events.details: The organiser describes the show as child-friendly. Afterwards the performers remove their masks and are available for photos. Finishing time is not published. Warm drinks and food are sold separately.
events.admission: Free entry. Optional food and drinks cost extra.

events.language: Spoken announcements are not specified; the focus is the visual parade and show.
events.title: Böhmischer Prater — Perchtenlauf
events.subtitle: Parade and fire show
events.description: A winter parade with elaborate masks and a fire show at the Böhmischer Prater.
events.details: The organiser’s full description confirms free entry and voluntary donations for children at Waldschule Wiener Neustadt. Arrive early because previous editions were busy. The organiser calls it child-friendly and asks visitors to let children see from the front.
events.admission: Free entry. Charity donations are voluntary; food, drinks and rides cost extra.
